findings.title: Company admin endpoints reachable without authentication
findings.evidence:
[AllowAnonymous]
[Route("api/[controller]")]
public class CompanyAdminController : ControllerBase
{
    [HttpPost("DeleteCompany")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteCompany(int companyId) => ...
    [HttpPost("ResetOwnerPassword")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ResetOwnerPassword(int companyId, string newPassword) => ...
}
findings.impact: Anyone on the internet can delete any customer's company or reset its owner's password without logging in. Rated Critical: no precondition, total loss of tenant data and account takeover.
findings.remediation: Remove [AllowAnonymous]; add [Authorize(Roles = CustomRoles.SuperAdmin)] on the class and verify the caller's claims in each action. Add an integration test that calls both endpoints without a token and expects 401.

findings.title: Order lookup has no ownership check
findings.evidence: var order = await _db.Orders.FindAsync(id); // id from route, no CompanyId/BranchId filter
findings.impact: Any authenticated customer can read every other customer's orders by changing the id in the URL.
findings.remediation: Filter by CompanyId and BranchId from the token claims in the base repository so every FindAsync inherits the filter; return 404 on mismatch.

findings.title: Invoice lookup has no ownership check
findings.impact: Same root cause as AUTHZ-002: any authenticated user can read other customers' invoices.
findings.remediation: Fixed by the base repository change in AUTHZ-002.
